title: Jason Arday: 22 days of coverage
subject: Coverage of Professor Jason Arday and institutional accountability
endNote: 15:12 BST cutoff on the final date

source.name: NewsCord
source.scopeNote: Daily totals are derived from NewsCord’s fixed 229-item inventory across 15 outlets. These four desks contain 90 listed pieces. The inventory has qualified indexing coverage and counts may be lower bounds. The last date stops at 15:12 BST. Examples are a small selection, not the counting population; original versions may have changed.

evidence.label: NewsCord article inventory and method
evidence.text: The fixed inventory lists 229 substantive written pieces from 15 outlets. This game selects four outlets and derives their daily counts from its dated rows.

evidence.label: Counting window and exclusions
evidence.text: 24 July to 14 August 2026, ending at 15:12 BST. Passing mentions, broadcasts and video-only items are excluded. Coverage of indexing gaps is qualified.

evidence.label: Resignation report, 5 August
evidence.text: Arday resigned from his Cambridge role on 5 August.

evidence.label: Independent inquiry report, 12 August
evidence.text: Cambridge agreed to an independent inquiry into his appointment on 12 August.

reasoningChecks.explanation: One unit is a substantive written item in the inventory, including news, comment or a letters page. It is not a count of proven attacks.

reasoningChecks.prompt: Do these four desks represent all UK coverage?

options.label: Yes, all UK outlets and formats
No, four outlets selected from a bounded inventory

reasoningChecks.explanation: These desks account for 90 listed pieces. The full fixed inventory lists 229 across 15 outlets; it has declared indexing gaps.

reasoningChecks.prompt: Does resignation automatically end the public interest?

options.label: Yes, every later item is excessive
No, any later volume is justified
No; later developments can justify further scrutiny

reasoningChecks.explanation: The subsequent inquiry is a documented development. Whether it warrants the actual amount of later coverage remains your campaign judgment.

reasoningChecks.prompt: What can a high daily peak establish by itself?
reasoningChecks.explanation: Daily totals show concentration. Intent, discrimination and consequences need additional evidence.

reasoningChecks.prompt: What does a zero in this archive mean?

options.label: No qualifying item is listed for that date

reasoningChecks.explanation: A zero describes the retrieved inventory. Indexing gaps and excluded formats prevent an absolute claim about all publication.
